brief.Text: Take these Permafrost Powered Tubes. Follow the dirty-snow path north. Six marks wait along it; the first sits under the Pipe. One Who Walks The Night is at the far end, 887 by 1781. {completequest XK0B}

progress.Text: North on the dirty-snow path. Mark each stretch. One Who Walks The Night waits at 887 by 1781.
